thread:
alex: quick check — running into an auth failure when importing the node TS SDK in a Next.js edge route. works fine in node server, but edge throws `TypeError: globalThis.crypto is undefined` and then token fetch fails. anyone seen this with ESM bundles?

maria: hmm. edge runtime doesn't have some node globals. are you bundling with next: "experimental-edge" or using Vite?

alex: Next 14 edge runtime, esm output. bundler is the Next internal one. import looks like: `import { RedwoodClient } from 'redwood-sdk'` then `const client = new RedwoodClient({ apiKey: process.env.REDWOOD_KEY })` — token handshake fails during client initialization.

jasper: do you have a stack trace? sometimes libraries call `crypto.randomBytes` or `Buffer` which blow up in edge.

alex: stack: `at Object.getRandomValues (crypto.js:45)` then `at UUID.generate` inside sdk. SDK calling node `crypto` poly that doesn't exist in V8 Isolates.

samir: two quick approaches: (1) use an ESM browser-friendly build of the SDK (we publish a `edge` export in package.json) or (2) lazy-load the auth piece via dynamic import so it's only run in node context.

olivia: we added an `edge` field in the SDK last quarter — try `import { RedwoodClient } from 'redwood-sdk/edge'` or `import RedwoodClient from 'redwood-sdk/esm/edge.js'` depending on bundler. that variant avoids node-only polyfills and uses webcrypto.

alex: tried `/edge` path, still get `ReferenceError: ReadableStreamDefaultReader is not defined` when attempting streaming response. looks like SDK tries to use `response.body.getReader()` which isn't supported in some edge flavors.

maria: Right — Cloudflare and Vercel edge have subtle differences. For streaming we should use web-streams iteration: `for await (const chunk of response.body)` instead of `getReader()` in some runtimes. Can you paste the snippet where you call streaming?

alex: it's internal inside sdk: `const stream = await fetch(...); const reader = stream.body.getReader(); while(true){ const {done, value} = await reader.read(); ... }`

jasper: that's the problem. Suggest we patch sdk edge build to use `if (stream.body.getReader) { ... } else if (stream.body[Symbol.asyncIterator]) { ... }`. I'll open a small PR.

samir: also watch bundler transforms — Next's edge bundler sometimes converts async iterators into generators that reference `regeneratorRuntime` if transpiled incorrectly. Make sure the edge build targets modern engines (no regenerator).

olivia: @jasper please also add a test that runs on `vercel/edge` and `node/edge` emulators. We previously missed one case where `TextDecoder` isn't global in the isolate.

alex: thanks. one more related: retries. The SDK's exponential backoff uses `setTimeout` and references `globalThis.setImmediate` in a fallback which isn't available on the edge. leads to infinite hang.

maria: edge runtimes have `setTimeout` but not `setImmediate`. Replace `setImmediate` with a microtask: `Promise.resolve().then(fn)` or `queueMicrotask(fn)` where available. Safer to add `if (typeof queueMicrotask !== 'undefined') queueMicrotask(fn)` fallback chain.

jasper: will include both fixes (streams + microtask) in the PR. also add a doc note for DevEx about recommended import paths per bundler.

alex: awesome. any temporary workaround for teams blocked right now? we have a customers-facing canary.

samir: short term: run the call from a serverless function (node) instead of edge; or if you must run in edge, switch to the SDK's HTTP-only minimal client (no streaming, no retries) — `import { fetchAuthToken } from 'redwood-sdk/minimal'` then call the REST endpoints directly.

olivia: pushed `deploy-bot` canary image to staging with jasper's quick stream-guard patch (non-prod only). deploy-bot: canary build 2026.3.12-rc1 rolled to staging :rocket:

alex: verified staging — auth handshake now passes, streaming falls back to async iterator. retry behavior still flaky in edge though.

jasper: pushed PR #842 with fixes + tests. pinging devex to add a short note to the SDK docs about `edge` import paths and `bundleTarget: 'es2022'` recommendation for Next/Vite edge apps.

maria: cc @devex-team — can you add a small troubleshooting doc for ESM/CJS edge gotchas (crypto, stream readers, setImmediate, TextEncoder/Decoder)? customers keep hitting this.

olivia: tagging folks: @samir please add a migration note to changelog. @alex please follow up tomorrow if the retry fix doesn't land in prod.

alex: will do. thanks all :thumbsup:

jasper: action items: PR 842 (streams + microtask), tests for vercel & node isolates, doc PR to devex.

olivia: ETA: will try to get patch out today, maybe tomorrow at latest. we'll canary and then promote.

alex: super. leaving this thread open for follow-ups. if anyone has a reproduction repo, drop link here and I'll try it on our canary.
